_README_1: PASTE YOUR RAZORPAY PAYMENT PAGE LINK ABOVE, between the empty quotes on the first line.
_README_3: Get it from your Razorpay Dashboard: Payment Pages -> open your page -> copy its link.
_README_4: Keep the quotes and the comma exactly as they are. Only the text inside the quotes changes.
_README_5: The flow is: Book Now -> this Razorpay page. The customer enters their details once, on Razorpay.
_README_6: While this is empty, Book Now takes the customer to the Contact page instead, so the button still leads somewhere useful. It never pretends a booking was paid.
_README_7: No Razorpay API key is needed. A hosted Payment Page needs no key, and no secret is ever stored in this website.
_README_8: After changing this, the website must be published again ('deploy') for it to take effect.
_README_9: Full instructions are in the file README.md, in this same folder.
